SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.name AS name, e.work_email AS workEmail, e.department_id AS departmentId, d.name AS departmentName, e.rank_id AS rankId, r.name AS rankName, r.display_order AS rankOrder, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.status AS status FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN ranks r ON r.rank_id = e.rank_id
ORDER BY e.name DESCASC, e.employee_id ASC
ORDER BY e.hire_date DESCASC, e.employee_id ASC
ORDER BY r.display_order ASC NULLS LAST, e.name ASC, e.employee_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.name AS name, e.work_email AS workEmail, e.department_id AS departmentId, d.name AS departmentName, e.rank_id AS rankId, r.name AS rankName, e.hire_date AS hireDate, e.birth_date AS birthDate, e.status AS status, e.invited_at AS invitedAt, e.activated_at AS activatedAt, e.terminated_at AS terminatedAt FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN ranks r ON r.rank_id = e.rank_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
